summary: Frontend-only testing of Heartlink UI/UX Phase 1 (safe area) + Phase 2 (Tinder-style Discover). Login flow works, Discover renders full-screen card with action buttons NOT overlapping the bottom navbar. Like/Pass advance to next profile. Navigation across Discover/Likes/Alerts/Chats/Profile works correctly with navbar consistently positioned at bottom.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: API is not defined in fetchLikes() — data fetch fails on /likes page (console error). Page still renders empty state, but 'Likes You' will never populate.

issues: --safe-bottom resolves to 0px in non-native browser (expected behavior), --nav-height=52px. On mobile web this leaves gesture/URL-bar unaccounted for; only Capacitor native gets +12px fallback. Consider a small default (~8px) for mobile web too.

action_items: Fix LikesYouPage.jsx: import { API } from '@/config/api' (or replace API with correct constant). Currently throws ReferenceError on load.
Minor: fix React warning 'Received `true` for a non-boolean attribute jsx' (styled-jsx or <style jsx> attribute leaking into DOM).
Consider adding non-zero fallback for --safe-bottom on mobile web browsers (currently 0px unless env(safe-area-inset-bottom) is non-zero).
critical_code_review_comments: DiscoverPage.jsx (455 lines) is approaching size limit — consider extracting ProfileCard, ActionButtons, OutOfSwipesModal into components.

DiscoverPage useEffect: WebSocket handler returns early via `return () => unsubscribe()` before the swipe-count localStorage initialization block runs. On mount when user.id is truthy (always in this app), daily swipe count and extra swipes are NEVER initialized from localStorage — they stay at 0 on every reload. This is a latent bug.
safeArea.js measure(): uses window.screen.height - window.innerHeight as gap heuristic; on rotated/split-screen this can produce inflated bottom insets. Guard against gap > 200 too.
DiscoverPage: action buttons overlap the profile info's bottom padding (pb-24) — works currently but is fragile if bio length grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint is /auth (not /login). Use placeholder 'Enter email or phone' and 'Enter password'. Submit via [data-testid="login-submit-btn"]. Daily reward modal can be dismissed via any [data-testid*="close"] button. Discover page has data-testids: profile-card, pass-btn, like-btn, superlike-btn, bottom-nav, and nav-{discover,likes,notifications,matches,profile}. Nav sits at y=791..844 on 390x844 viewport; action buttons rest at y=716..776 with clear gap. LikesYouPage has undefined `API` ReferenceError — needs import fix in E1.
rca of the issue: LikesYouPage.jsx uses `API` constant without importing it from '@/config/api'. Runtime throws inside fetchLikes on mount; caught by axios/catch block but logs error. Fix: add `import { API } from '@/config/api';` at top of file.
